blockingFindings.description: V15 direct crouch and sit renders still show broad fitted shorts under the lifted overskirt. Source-bound ray coverage falls to crouch upper thigh L/R 0.2983/0.2814 and sit 0.1955/0.1853. This diagnostic is geometric evidence only and does not establish fit.

The panel-local two-fold-per-panel field and 4 mm radial amplitude soften the front silhouette, but neutral front/back/profile still lack clearly readable regular pleats; back and right-side panels retain uneven angular faceting and abrupt panel transitions.

V15 all-panel thigh-follow weights reduce overskirt coverage against the posed thighs versus V14; crouch and seated renders lift the hem and expose the shorts over a large area. Current weights are an unapproved deformation hypothesis.
Direct five-view and six-pose review still shows a mostly plain ivory jacket, broad diagonal lavender chest panel, faint elbow channels, and no visible center-back waist adjustment tab.
No authored UV layout exists for the current weighted garment mesh; UV status remains NOT_CREATED.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
